title: Hexanuclear 3d–4f Neutral CoII2LnIII4 Clusters: Synthesis, Structure, and Magnetism

material_class.structural_family: Co2Ln4 hexanuclear cluster with incomplete cubic CoLn2O4 and Ln3O4 subunits

synthesis.procedure: General protocol for 1–3: a methanolic solution (5 mL) of Ln(NO3)3·xH2O (3 equiv) was added dropwise to a 20 mL methanolic solution of LH2 (2 equiv) and triethylamine (8 equiv) with stirring. Solid Co(ClO4)2·6H2O (3 equiv) was added and the mixture was stirred for 1.5 h to give a deep pink solution. Pivalic acid (4 equiv) was added and stirring was continued for 12 h. The pink solution was dried in vacuo; the residue was redissolved in acetonitrile/dichloromethane (1:1), filtered, and crystallized by slow evaporation at room temperature. After 1 week, brown block-shaped crystals were obtained. For 1 the stated reactant amounts were Co(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.062 g, 0.169 mmol), Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.077 g, 0.170 mmol), LH2 (0.044 g, 0.113 mmol), Et3N (0.046 g, 0.454 mmol), and pivalic acid (0.023 g, 0.225 mmol).

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility and magnetization of the Co2Gd4 cluster are consistent with uncoupled GdIII plus octahedral CoII (orbital contribution). Room-temperature χMT is 35.0 cm3 K mol−1. M(H) at 2 K reaches 30.5 NμB at 7 T without saturation. M(H/T) at 2 and 4 K do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy and/or low-lying excited states. No slow magnetization dynamics were reported for 1.

properties.summary: The Co2Dy4 cluster shows χMT = 59.7 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature and M = 24.6 NμB at 2 K/7 T without saturation. It is the only analogue with slow magnetization relaxation: under a 0.1 T static field, both χ′ and χ″ become frequency-dependent below ca. 7 K (ac field 1.55 G, 1–1400 Hz). No slow relaxation was observed in zero dc field.
